title: brya buxifolia
intro: Brya buxifolia, commonly known as the "wild olive tree" or "wild olive", is a flowering plant native to the Americas. It is a shrub or small tree that belongs to the family Fabaceae, which includes legumes. The health benefits of Brya buxifolia include its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Its therapeutic actions include sedative, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids.
